recipes.name: Slow Cooker Sweet and Tangy Chicken

steps.text: In a large bowl, mix together barbecue sauce, pineapple with juice, green bell pepper, onion, and garlic.
Arrange 4 of the chicken breasts in the bottom of a slow cooker. Pour half of the barbecue sauce over the chicken. Place remaining chicken in slow cooker, and pour remaining sauce over the top.
Cover, and cook on Low for 8 to 9 hours.

review.reviewBody: Here is the secret...#1 Use Sweet Baby Ray's HONEY BARBEQUE SAUCE, and you won't need any additional sweetness, #2 Use CRUSHED PINEAPPLE INSTEAD OF CHUNKS, and #3 Use Boneless Chicken Thigh meat or dark meat. I used thigh meat, and chopped into cubes oh and i used the red onions instead of yellow, and i doubled the peppers and added red and orange peppers also and about 5 min before i served it, i added 2 bunches of chopped green onions to the pot and served with chicken fried rice asian sides. It was awesome!

First off I am a novice and loved this recipe for its ease and delicious taste! Read many of the reviews before I decided a course of action. It was a ninety degree day but i wanted a special meal for a birthday dinner and that's what I got. Put five plump chicken breasts in the crock pot on high with 1 18 oz. bottle of original Sweet Baby Ray's barbecue sauce and the juice from a 15 oz. can of crushed pineapple and some garlic. At four hours I shredded chicken added 3 peppers: green, yellow, and red, with some carrots. Along with the crushed pineapple from one can, I also added about a half of another mix of sauce and pineapple juice,feeling more sauce was needed with the addition of the veggies. The taste was delish, a nice balance of all ingredients and a recipe that would be tasty with just the meat. We all had seconds! (Used new six and a half quart crockpot.) Total cook time was five hours on high.

this worked very well.. used sweet baby ray's original bbq sauce. I about doubled the pineapple because I liked it. I covered the chicken in a baking dish and just baked at 350 for about 40 minutes, turned out perfectly.

Five Stars because the whole family LOVED it. Even the picky eaters had seconds and thirds. Used one bottle of Sweet Baby Rays, 2 cans of pineapple chuncks, (one with the juice, one drained). 6 chicken breasts. Cooked 4 hours on low, then turned to warm for 3 more hours.....perfect. Served over white rice.

Yum! Que sabroso! I wanted MORE sauce! (I'm not understanding how people thought there was too much sauce.)

I used every drop of two 18-oz bottles of Sweet Baby Ray's Honey BBQ sauce and one can of crushed (not chunk) pineapple with all the juice. I used 2 green peppers instead of one. Garlic and red onion as directed. I used 8 skinless boneless chicken thighs. (My experience is that dark meat chicken is the best to use in a slow cooker. Breasts dry out in a slow cooker.) 

I cooked it on low for 8 hours and it wasn't overcooked at all. Perhaps that's because I used dark meat instead of breasts. Dark meat cooks more slowly.

Served over rice. Kids ages 11, 13 and 13 raved about it.

Next time, I will double all the ingredients except the chicken. Like I said, I wanted more sauce!

This was tasty. I put in 8 frozen boneless chicken breasts and set the slow cooker on low and cooked them for 5.5 hours and everything was perfectly cooked. I didn't use 2 full bottles of sauce, just 1.5 and there was still lots of sauce leftover. My fiance says this is a definite must for another time.

Was skeptical because of the reviews but this is delish. I salt & peppered chicken thighs & seasoned with a little garlic powder. I also added about 2 tbsp of honey for a little extra sweetness. I used a large yellow onion, 1 green pepper & 1 red pepper. I also used sweet baby rays honey bbq sauce. Definitely a keeper. Oh and only cook on high for about 3.5 to 4 hrs.

Followed exactly as written except decreased 2 bottles of BBQ sauce to about a bottle and a half and it was fine. Did thicken with some cornstarch at the end but you don't have to do that, still tasted great. Only cooked for 6 hours as well and it was done. Used Sweet Baby Ray's Honey BBQ as suggested by others. It is a different taste, much sweeter but it grows on you! My husband LOVED it. If you like a sweeter BBQ taste, give it a try! VERY easy to make!!

IF I make this again, I will reduce the cooking time to about 7 hours instead of 9. My chicken turned out a bit dry. The sauce was very flavorful, but runny. I added some cornstarch to it to thicken it up. I used Sweet Baby Ray's original sauce (about 1 and 1/2 bottles)

Thought this was good but lacked the tang. I agree with others that the sauce is too thin. I dissolved about 1/2 cup cornstarch in 1/2 cup vinegar and added it at the end, with the crockpot on high. That gave the thickness and tang I was looking for. Also, FYI, I used skinless, bone-in chicken thighs and it was so great.

This was pretty good. Definitely can't cook longer then 6-7 hours, it would be too long. We used a Sweet baby rays (honey) bbq and chunk pineapple. Because of the sweet bbq sauce, I added a hot pepper with the other peppers and a dash of red pepper flakes to even it out. Our sauce was a good consistancy, as we used a whole bottle bbq, small can of pineapple for 3 chicken breasts. Served with rice. Will make again!
So easy but so good...I was bummed I only had a large can of crushed pineapple but it seemed to work well. Was great over rice with a side of broccoli. I would definitely make it again
I make this all the time. Love this recipe! The only thing I add is water chestnuts. My kids love this as well.
authentic taste no need for takeaway when you can produce meal to this standard
Will definitely make again, exactly as is.
added more onions and used minced garlic
added more onions and used minced garlic

Note, I only used one bottle of BBQ sauce and cut the amount of chicken. very easy and nice contrast with the BBQ sauce and pineapple. Chunks worked fine. Next time I make will add more ingredients, like cashews and other peppers
delicious!
This was great! I reduced the amounts because I only made 4 chicken breasts but it was sooo good!
